phase_policy.M1_M3: Structure suggestions and user confirmation; deterministic trace and evidence baseline only.
phase_policy.M4: Bounded univariate representation search, recovery, local Gateway capture, RAG and compaction.
phase_policy.M5: Multi-approach verification and checked backward proofs.
phase_policy.M6_M7: New major contracts for multivariate/multiseries, advanced inverse problems and controlled training.

corrections: Do not select representations with final_test scores.
Do not infer physical time or true latent dimension from column count.
Do not equate stream chunks, retokenized tokens and provider-exact token IDs.
Do not promise ADAPTER compatibility without runtime/model-specific verification.
Do not treat model consensus, p-values or LLM self-confidence as probability of truth.
Do not treat the source assistant hardware, deployment and budget examples as approved facts.
